name: singlet_disease_clinical_gwas_cell_level_scoring
title: Per-cell GWAS disease-relevance score
description: Scores every cell for one trait from GWAS-implicated gene weights and returns a calibrated per-cell p-value against expression-matched random control gene sets. Use method scdrs by default; raw_weighted_mean is an uncalibrated comparator only. Needs log1p size-normalised counts in a layer and a .gs trait gene-set file. Writes per-cell score, p-value and optional group members. Do not use for cell-type-level enrichment or for per-sample phenotype labels.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

gene_set.description: Trait gene-set file (.gs, with a TRAIT line and gene:weight pairs) or a handle to one stored in the dataset.

method.description: scdrs gives calibrated per-cell p-values; raw_weighted_mean gives the uncalibrated comparator score.

layer.description: Layer of log1p size-normalised counts; the tool does not normalise counts itself.

group_key.description: Optional categorical obs column; when set, writes group FDR proportions and association tests.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for control gene draws; with the same inputs it fixes the output.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

scdrs.description: Options used when method is scdrs.

n_ctrl.description: Matched control gene sets; the Monte Carlo p-value cannot fall below 1/(1+n_ctrl).

n_genebin.description: Quantile bins on mean and variance used to match control genes.

weight_opt.description: vs weights genes by inverse regularised technical standard deviation; uniform weights all trait genes equally.

covariates.description: obs columns regressed out of expression before scoring.

return_ctrl_norm_score.description: Also write normalised control scores to obsm for downstream group tests.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obs/T2D_scdrs_pval. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: trait, n_cells, n_genes_in_set, mapped_fraction, n_ctrl, p_floor_mc, n_cells_q_below_0_1 (completed runs only).

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
